newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai sets net overseas earnings at $13 bln.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai sets net overseas earnings at $13 bln.

text.p: Hyundai Group, one of South Korea's three largest conglomerates, said on Monday it has set its net overseas earnings target at $13 billion for this year, up from $10 billion in 1996.
Hyundai said in a statement the group planned to boost exports by its 50 member firms to $17.3 billion in 1997 from $15.2 billion in 1996.
"In addition, we are expected to make some $3.2 billion in earnings from overseas transportation, and $2.1 billion from overseas construction and engineering projects," said the statement.

The group's imports were expected to rise slightly to $9.6 billion in 1997, up from $9.5 billion. Hyundai earlier said it had set its sales target for this year at 80 trillion won against an estimated 70 trillion won in 1996.
